apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: trak-api
  labels:

spec:
  replicas: 3

  selector:
    matchLabels:

            memory: "512Mi"

children.content:
# ☸️ Kubernetes Architecture, Controllers & SRE Mastery Track

Welcome to the **Kubernetes Architecture, Controllers & SRE Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering Kubernetes Control Plane internals (etcd, kube-apiserver, scheduler), Pod lifecycles, zero-downtime rolling updates, StatefulSets, NetworkPolicies, Helm charts, Operator reconciliation loops, and production troubleshooting.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-control-plane-architecture` | Control Plane & Worker Internals | `kube-apiserver`, `etcd` Raft consensus, `kubelet`, `kube-proxy`, `kubectl` |
| `01-pods-and-multi-container-patterns` | Pod Lifecycle & Sidecars | Pod states, initContainers, sidecar pattern, ephemeral debugging containers |
| `02-deployments-and-replicasets` | Deployments & Rollouts | RollingUpdate (`maxSurge`/`maxUnavailable`), zero-downtime deployments, rollback |
| `03-services-and-kube-proxy-networking` | Services & Service Discovery | ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer, `kube-proxy` (iptables vs IPVS), CoreDNS |
| `04-ingress-controllers-and-gateway-api` | Ingress & Gateway API | Ingress-Nginx, TLS termination (`cert-manager`), Gateway API (`HTTPRoute`) |
| `05-configmaps-and-secrets` | ConfigMaps & Secrets | ConfigMaps, Secrets, Projected Volumes, External Secrets Operator |
| `06-storage-pv-pvc-and-storageclasses` | Storage (PV, PVC, CSI) | PersistentVolumes, PVCs, StorageClasses, dynamic provisioning, CSI drivers |
| `07-statefulsets-and-headless-services` | StatefulSets & Headless Services | Stable network identities (`pod-0`), VolumeClaimTemplates, ordered startup |
| `08-daemonsets-and-jobs-cronjobs` | DaemonSets, Jobs & CronJobs | Node-level DaemonSets (Fluentbit), batch Jobs, CronJob scheduling |
| `09-resource-management-and-hpa` | Resources & Autoscaling (HPA) | Requests & limits (millicores, MiB), QoS classes, HPA v2 custom metrics |
| `10-probes-liveness-readiness-startup` | Health Probes Architecture | StartupProbe, LivenessProbe (restart), ReadinessProbe (endpoint isolation) |
| `11-node-scheduling-affinity-and-taints` | Advanced Scheduling | NodeSelector, NodeAffinity, PodAntiAffinity, Taints and Tolerations |
| `12-security-rbac-serviceaccounts` | RBAC & Security | Roles, ClusterRoles, RoleBindings, ServiceAccounts, Projected Tokens |
| `13-network-policies-and-cni` | NetworkPolicies & CNI | Default Deny, ingress/egress rules, Calico / Cilium eBPF packet routing |
| `14-helm-package-manager` | Helm Charts & Packaging | Chart templates, `values.yaml`, `helm upgrade --install --atomic`, subcharts |
| `15-crds-and-operator-pattern` | CRDs & Operator Pattern | Custom Resource Definitions, reconciliation loop (`Reconcile`), Kubebuilder |
| `16-cluster-monitoring-prometheus-grafana` | Monitoring & Metrics | Prometheus Operator, ServiceMonitors, Grafana, kube-state-metrics |
| `17-troubleshooting-and-debugging` | SRE Troubleshooting | `kubectl describe`, previous logs (`-p`), CrashLoopBackOff, ImagePullBackOff |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Kubernetes SRE gotchas + Zero-Downtime Rolling Deployment Drill |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `manifest.yaml` / `example.sh` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.yaml` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.yaml` — Complete reference solution.

# 00 — Control Plane & Worker Node Internals

## 🎯 Control Plane Components
- **kube-apiserver**: Stateless REST API gateway validating and persisting state to `etcd`.
- **etcd**: Consistent, highly-available key-value database utilizing Raft consensus.
- **kube-scheduler**: Assigns unscheduled Pods to optimal Nodes based on resource constraints.
- **kube-controller-manager**: Runs core control loops (Deployment, Node, EndpointSlice controllers).

children.name: example.sh
children.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "=== 00: Kubernetes Cluster Status ==="
if command -v kubectl &>/dev/null; then
  kubectl cluster-info 2>/dev/null || echo "kubectl CLI installed; connecting to cluster..."
else
  echo "kubectl CLI not in PATH."
fi

children.name: starter.sh
solution.sh
children.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
kubectl get nodes -o wide 2>/dev/null || echo "kubectl get nodes -o wide"

# 02 — Zero-Downtime Rolling Updates

## 🎯 RollingUpdate Parameters
- `maxSurge: 1`: Allows 1 additional temporary Pod during update (`desired + 1`).
- `maxUnavailable: 0`: Guarantees 100% capacity remains online throughout rollout.

echo "kubectl rollout status deployment/trak-api"
echo "kubectl rollout history deployment/trak-api"
echo "kubectl rollout undo deployment/trak-api"

# 03 — Services & kube-proxy (iptables vs IPVS)

## 🎯 Service Types
- **ClusterIP**: Internal stable virtual IP inside cluster.
- **NodePort**: Exposes static port on every Node (30000-32767).
- **LoadBalancer**: Provisions cloud provider external load balancer.

# 06 — Storage: PV, PVC & CSI Dynamic Provisioning

## 🎯 Access Modes
- `ReadWriteOnce` (RWO): Mountable read-write by a single Node.
- `ReadOnlyMany` (ROX): Mountable read-only by multiple Nodes.
- `ReadWriteMany` (RWX): Mountable read-write by multiple Nodes simultaneously (NFS, EFS).

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: data-pvc
spec:
  accessModes:
    - ReadWriteOnce
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 20Gi
  storageClassName: gp3

  volumes:
  - name: storage-vol
    persistentVolumeClaim:
      claimName: data-pvc
  containers:
  - name: app
    image: redis:7-alpine
    volumeMounts:
    - name: storage-vol
      mountPath: /var/lib/data

# 07 — StatefulSets & Stable Network Identifiers

## 🎯 StatefulSet Guarantees
- Deterministic names: `kafka-0`, `kafka-1`, `kafka-2`.
- Dedicated persistent storage attached per replica via `volumeClaimTemplates`.

children.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: redis-cluster
spec:
  serviceName: "redis-service"
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: redis-cluster
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: redis-cluster
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: redis
        image: redis:7-alpine
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: redis-data
    spec:
      accessModes: [ "ReadWriteOnce" ]
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 5Gi

# 08 — DaemonSets & Batch CronJobs

## 🎯 DaemonSets
Ensures a copy of the Pod runs on every single worker node (ideal for FluentBit, Prometheus node-exporter, Datadog).

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: database-backup
spec:
  schedule: "0 2 * * *"
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        spec:
          containers:
          - name: backup
            image: postgres:16-alpine
            command: ["/bin/sh", "-c", "echo Backup complete"]
          restartPolicy: OnFailure

# 09 — Quality of Service (QoS) & Horizontal Pod Autoscaler

## 🎯 QoS Classes
- **Guaranteed**: Requests == Limits for both CPU and Memory (lowest eviction priority).
- **Burstable**: Requests < Limits.
- **BestEffort**: No requests or limits specified (first to be OOM killed under node pressure!).

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
metadata:
  name: trak-api-hpa
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    apiVersion: apps/v1
    kind: Deployment
    name: trak-api
  minReplicas: 2
  maxReplicas: 10
  metrics:
  - type: Resource
    resource:
      name: cpu
      target:
        type: Utilization
        averageUtilization: 75

# 10 — Health Probes: Startup, Liveness & Readiness

## 🎯 Probe Responsibilities
- **StartupProbe**: Disables liveness checks until slow startup finishes.
- **LivenessProbe**: Kills and restarts hung/deadlocked containers.
- **ReadinessProbe**: Removes unready Pods from Service load balancing endpoints.

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
readinessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /ready
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 3
  periodSeconds: 5
livenessProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  initialDelaySeconds: 10
  periodSeconds: 10

children.name: starter.yaml
children.content:
# TODO: Define a startupProbe allowing up to 30 failures with 5-second period for slow booting apps.
# FILL HERE

children.name: solution.yaml
children.content:
startupProbe:
  httpGet:
    path: /healthz
    port: 8080
  failureThreshold: 30
  periodSeconds: 5

children.content:
# 11 — Advanced Scheduling: Affinity & Taints

## 🎯 Concepts
- **Affinity**: Attracts Pods to specific Nodes or co-locates with specific Pods.
- **Taints & Tolerations**: Repels Pods from Nodes unless the Pod explicitly tolerates the taint (e.g. GPU nodes).

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
spec:
  affinity:
    nodeAffinity:
      requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
        nodeSelectorTerms:
        - matchExpressions:
          - key: topology.kubernetes.io/zone
            operator: In
            values:
            - us-east-1a
            - us-east-1b

children.name: starter.yaml
children.content:
# TODO: Add podAntiAffinity to spread pods across different nodes.
# FILL HERE

children.name: solution.yaml
children.content:
podAntiAffinity:
    preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
    - weight: 100
      podAffinityTerm:
        labelSelector:
          matchExpressions:
          - key: app
            operator: In
            values: ["trak-api"]
        topologyKey: "kubernetes.io/hostname"

# 12 — Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

## 🎯 RBAC Structure
```text
[ ServiceAccount ] ──(RoleBinding)──▶ [ Role ] ──▶ [ API Verbs on Resources ]
```

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  namespace: default
  name: pod-reader
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods", "services"]
  verbs: ["get", "watch", "list"]

kind: RoleBinding

  name: read-pods-binding
  namespace: default
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: app-sa
  namespace: default

  kind: Role
  name: pod-reader
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io

# 13 — NetworkPolicies & Default Deny

## 🎯 Zero-Trust Network Isolation
By default, all Pods can communicate with all other Pods. Apply Default Deny NetworkPolicy to enforce explicit traffic whitelisting.

children.name: manifest.yaml
children.content:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-all
  namespace: default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress

# FILL HERE

children.content:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-backend-to-db
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: database
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: backend
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 5432

# 17 — Production SRE Troubleshooting

## 🎯 Common Failure States
- `CrashLoopBackOff`: Application crashing on startup (check `kubectl logs -p`).
- `ImagePullBackOff`: Bad image name, tag, or missing imagePullSecret.
- `OOMKilled`: Container exceeded memory limit (exit code 137).
- `Pending`: No node with sufficient CPU/RAM or node taint un-tolerated.

children.name: example.sh
children.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
echo "=== 17: Production Debugging Flow ==="
echo "1. kubectl describe pod <pod_name>"
echo "2. kubectl logs <pod_name> --previous"
echo "3. kubectl get events --sort-by='.metadata.creationTimestamp'"

children.name: starter.sh
solution.sh
children.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
kubectl get pods -A --field-selector=status.phase!=Running,status.phase!=Succeeded 2>/dev/null || echo "Command executed."

# 18 — High-Yield Kubernetes SRE Interview Drills

## 🧠 Top 10 Gotchas
1. **etcd Quorum Loss**: In a 3-node etcd cluster, loss of 2 nodes loses quorum and makes apiserver read-only.
2. **CPU Throttling vs Memory OOM**: CPU exceeding limit is throttled (CFS quota); memory exceeding limit is instantly killed (OOM 137).
3. **Readiness Probe Failure**: Fails to receive traffic but continues running; Liveness probe failure restarts the container.
4. **Service IP Non-Pingable**: ClusterIPs are virtual iptables/IPVS rules and do not respond to ICMP ping.
5. **DNS CoreDNS Bottleneck**: Excessive lookups of single-label hosts cause 5-second DNS delays with ndots:5.
6. **StatefulSet Split-Brain**: Never force delete (`--force --grace-period=0`) a StatefulSet pod on a partitioned node.
7. **`emptyDir` Lifecycle**: Deleted permanently when the Pod is deleted from the node.
8. **Node Drain Eviction**: Respects PodDisruptionBudgets (PDB); unevictable pods stall maintenance.
9. **CNI IP Exhaustion**: Subnet CIDR per node limits max pods per node.
10. **Secret Base64 Encoding**: Base64 is encoding, not encryption; requires KMS envelope encryption at rest.

echo "1. Control Plane & etcd Raft consensus"
echo "2. Zero-Downtime RollingUpdate & PDBs"
echo "3. NetworkPolicies Zero-Trust isolation"
echo "4. Operator pattern reconciliation loop"
echo "🚀 You have completed the comprehensive Kubernetes Mastery Track!"

apiVersion: policy/v1
kind: PodDisruptionBudget
metadata:
  name: trak-api-pdb
spec:

  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: trak-api
